_comment: Priming config for the colour-leakage probe. The runner builds one condition per colour (prime_<colour>) whose single prefix exchange is (user_ask, assistant_template with the colour slotted in), plus a length-matched 'neutral' condition (assistant states no favourite) and 'B0' (no prefix at all). Assistant templates are length-matched across colours (they differ only by the colour word, ~1 token) so this does not repeat the length confound found in the persona-drift experiment.
user_ask: Quick aside before we get into it — if you had to pick just one, what's your favorite color?
assistant_template: Honestly? If I had to pick just one, I'd say {Colour}. There's something about {colour} that has always appealed to me, and I keep coming back to it.
assistant_neutral: Honestly? If I had to pick just one, I couldn't — I appreciate them all for different reasons depending on the setting, and I keep coming back to that.
